EXPEDITION FIELD GUIDE

Meaning leaves traces.

You are the first linguist to reach this silent world. An ancient archive still has power, but its inscriptions have never been translated.

  1. Observe. Inspect the vessel, garden, and threshold. Compare marks that recur in different contexts.
  2. Hypothesize. Assign meanings in your lexicon or beneath the inscription.
  3. Translate. Test each message. Use the evidence and grammar notes to revise your reading.

Drag the relic or use the rotation buttons. All evidence is also available through the three named site buttons.

We kept the water
for you.

You thought this was a warning.
It was an invitation.

The archive opens a path to reservoirs beneath the dry city. Whoever built it knew they might never meet the next arrivals. They left a language of light, water, and welcome.
